Corollary
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0105 1. Corollary 3.33\group harmonic-coordinates

In harmonic coordinates, the Ricci flow becomes a nonlinear heat equation for the metric components: \[ \partial _t g_{ij}=\Delta (g_{ij})+Q_{ij}(g^{-1},\partial g). \]
